column1: I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Officers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council
to disburse as per the Second Supplementary Financial Statement for the year 2025, by virtue of powers vested in me under
Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of
the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.
The  expenditure  of  the  Sabaragamuwa  Provincial  Council  which  is  estimated  Rupees  Sixty  Two  Billion  Two  Hundred
Eight Million Fifty Five Thousand Eighty Two and Twelve Cents only (Rs. 62,208,055,082.12) for the service of the period
beginning on 01st of January, 2025 and ending 31st December, 2025, which is specified in the Annual Financial Statement
and Revenue and Expenditure Estimates for the year 2025, is amended as Sixty Two Billion Five Hundred Twenty Two
Million Five Hundred Seventy Eight Thousand Seven Hundred Thirty Nine and Forty Five Cents (Rs. 62,522,578,739.45)
and grant permission to disbursse the same from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund.
This permission will be valid till 31st of December, 2025 or upto the date that expires three months (03) from the date of
